What the pickers offer, what the schedules are, and the credentials this page manages.

Reading needs **Read only** and changes need **Full**, unless an endpoint says otherwise. [How to read this page](/docs/integrations/api-reference/#how-to-read-a-group-page).

### `GET /api/health`

Liveness probe.

- **Level:** No key
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Returns:** `{ok: true}`

### `POST /api/feedback`

Send a question or an idea to this install's community; bugs go to GitHub from the browser.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Input:** `{summary, details, environment?}`
- **Returns:** `{ok: true}`

### `GET /api/meta`

PHP versions, locales, servers, dev domain, timezone - what the forms are built from.

- **Level:** Read only

### `GET /api/settings`

Every panel setting.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Returns:** `{settings}`

### `PUT /api/settings`

Change settings: schedules, retentions, limits, site defaults.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive
- **Input:** `any subset of the settings object`
- **Returns:** `{settings, jobs[]} - jobs: one per server when a site container limit changed`

### `GET /api/api-keys`

Your API keys (never the tokens).

- **Level:** Read only
- **Notes:** Not over MCP

### `POST /api/api-keys`

Create a key - the token is in this response and nowhere else.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Input:** `{name}`
- **Returns:** `201 {token, ...}`

### `DELETE /api/api-keys/:id`

Revoke a key immediately.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive · Not over MCP

### `GET /api/api-keys/activity`

The API request log behind the Activity tab.

- **Level:** Read only
- **Notes:** Not over MCP
- **Input:** `?keyId=&outcome=ok|error|denied&method=&search=&hours=&limit=&offset=`
- **Returns:** `{items, total, last24h, retentionDays, maxRows}`

### `DELETE /api/api-keys/activity`

Empty the request log now.

- **Level:** Full
- **Notes:** Destructive · Not over MCP
- **Returns:** `{removed}`
